title: ReaGeo: Reasoning-Enhanced End-to-End Geocoding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, submitted to ACM SIGSPATIAL 2024 (under review)
summary: This paper proposes ReaGeo, an end-to-end geocoding framework based on large language models, designed to overcome the limitations of traditional multi-stage approaches that rely on text or vector similarity retrieval over geographic databases, including workflow complexity, error propagation, and heavy dependence on structured geographic knowledge bases. The method converts geographic coordinates into geohash sequences, reformulating the coordinate prediction task as a text generation problem, and introduces a Chain-of-Thought mechanism to enhance the model's reasoning over spatial relationships. Furthermore, reinforcement learning with a distance-deviation-based reward is applied to optimize the generation accuracy. Comprehensive experiments show that ReaGeo can accurately handle explicit address queries in single-point predictions and effectively resolve vague relative location queries. In addition, the model demonstrates strong predictive capability for non-point geometric regions, highlighting its versatility and generalization ability in geocoding tasks.

AI.tldr: ReaGeo是一个基于大语言模型的端到端地理编码框架，通过将坐标预测转化为文本生成任务（使用geohash序列），结合思维链推理和基于距离偏差的强化学习，解决了传统多阶段地理编码方法的局限。
AI.motivation: 传统地理编码方法依赖多阶段流程（文本或向量相似度检索），存在工作流复杂、错误传播、严重依赖结构化地理知识库等问题。
AI.method: 1) 将地理坐标转换为geohash序列，将坐标预测任务重新定义为文本生成问题；2) 引入思维链(Chain-of-Thought)机制增强模型对空间关系的推理能力；3) 采用基于距离偏差奖励的强化学习优化生成精度。
AI.result: ReaGeo能够准确处理显式地址查询的单点预测，有效解决模糊的相对位置查询，并对非点几何区域展示出强大的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了在地理编码任务中的通用性和泛化能力，克服了传统多阶段方法的局限性。
idea_en: A method for converting geographic coordinates into geohash sequences to reformulate coordinate prediction as a text generation task for LLM-based geocoding.
Integration of Chain-of-Thought reasoning mechanism into geocoding to enhance spatial relationship reasoning in large language models.
Reinforcement learning optimization for geocoding using a distance-deviation-based reward function to improve coordinate generation accuracy.

title: Time, Causality, and Observability Failures in Distributed AI Inference Systems
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Produced as part of the Unified Intelligent Infrastructure workstream at the Open Compute Project (OCP)
summary: Distributed AI inference pipelines rely heavily on timestamp-based observability to understand system behavior. This work demonstrates that even small clock skew between nodes can cause observability to become causally incorrect while the system itself remains functionally correct and performant. We present controlled experiments on a multi-node AI inference pipeline, where clock skew is introduced at a single stage. Results show that no violations are observed under synchronized conditions and up to 3 ms skew, while clear causality violations emerge by 5 ms. Despite this, system throughput and output correctness remain largely unaffected. We further observe that violation behavior is not strictly static. In longer runs, negative span rates may stabilize or decrease over time, indicating that effective skew evolves due to relative clock drift between nodes. Experiments were conducted using Kafka and ZeroMQ transports, with consistent results across both. Aeron is under active exploration but is not yet included in the completed validation set. These findings suggest that observability correctness depends not only on system functionality but also on precise time alignment, and that timing must be treated as a first-class concern in distributed AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分布式AI推理管道中，即使节点间存在微小时钟偏差（5ms以上），也会导致基于时间戳的可观测性出现因果错误，而系统本身的功能和性能不受影响。
AI.motivation: 分布式AI推理管道依赖时间戳进行可观测性分析，但时钟偏差可能导致观测数据因果错误，本文旨在量化这一影响并引起重视。
AI.method: 在多节点AI推理管道中，在单个阶段人工引入时钟偏差，使用Kafka和ZeroMQ两种传输方式，在不同偏差水平下测量因果违规率、吞吐量和输出正确性。
AI.result: 同步和3ms偏差下无违规，5ms偏差出现明显因果违规；系统吞吐量和输出正确性基本不受影响；长时间运行中负跨度率可能稳定或下降，表明有效偏差随时钟漂移变化。
AI.conclusion: 可观测性正确性不仅依赖于系统功能，还依赖于精确的时间对齐，时间应作为分布式AI系统的一等公民来对待。
idea_en: A method for detecting clock skew-induced causality violations in distributed AI inference pipelines using span-level latency analysis without requiring synchronized clocks.
A technique for dynamically estimating effective clock skew between distributed nodes by monitoring the rate of negative spans over time, enabling adaptive time correction.

A system for decoupling observability correctness from functional correctness in distributed AI pipelines, where observability data is timestamped with logical clocks or vector clocks instead of physical timestamps.
A method for inserting artificial clock skew at a single pipeline stage to systematically test and validate the robustness of observability frameworks in distributed inference systems.
A transport-agnostic clock skew calibration protocol for distributed AI inference that works across Kafka, ZeroMQ, and Aeron messaging systems.

title: SemanticAgent: A Semantics-Aware Framework for Text-to-SQL Data Synthesis
summary: Existing text-to-SQL synthesis pipelines still conflate executability with semantic validity: syntactic checks and execution-based validation can retain queries that execute successfully while violating database semantics. To address these limitations, we propose SemanticAgent, a semantic-aware synthesis framework. SemanticAgent organizes synthesis around three specialized modules: an analyzer, a synthesizer, and a verifier. Through a three-stage protocol of semantic analysis, stepwise synthesis, and diagnostic refinement, SemanticAgent transforms execution-based validation alone into a traceable reasoning process. Our framework generates synthetic data that consistently outperforms prior synthesis methods under semantic-quality evaluation, leading to stronger downstream fine-tuning performance, especially on semantically demanding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出SemanticAgent，一个语义感知的Text-to-SQL合成框架，通过分析器、合成器和验证器三个模块及三阶段协议，解决现有方法混淆可执行性与语义有效性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL合成流程将可执行性与语义有效性混为一谈，语法检查和基于执行的验证可能保留执行成功但违反数据库语义的查询。
AI.method: 提出SemanticAgent框架，包含三个专门模块：分析器(analyzer)、合成器(synthesizer)和验证器(verifier)。采用三阶段协议：语义分析(semantic analysis)、逐步合成(stepwise synthesis)和诊断细化(diagnostic refinement)，将单纯的执行验证转化为可追溯的推理过程。
AI.result: 生成的合成数据在语义质量评估中始终优于先前的合成方法，在下游微调任务上表现更强，尤其是在语义要求高的基准测试上。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知的合成框架能够生成更高质量的SQL数据，有效解决执行成功但语义错误的问题。
idea_en: A semantic-aware SQL synthesis framework with three specialized modules (analyzer, synthesizer, verifier) that decouples executability from semantic validity.
A three-stage protocol (semantic analysis, stepwise synthesis, diagnostic refinement) that transforms execution-based validation into a traceable reasoning process for SQL generation.
A diagnostic refinement mechanism that identifies and corrects semantically invalid SQL queries that would otherwise pass execution-based validation.
A method for generating synthetic text-to-SQL training data that enforces semantic constraints beyond syntactic correctness and executability.

一种生成合成Text-to-SQL训练数据的方法，在语法正确性和可执行性之外强制施加语义约束。

title: FairQE: Multi-Agent Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias in Translation Quality Estimation
summary: Quality Estimation (QE) aims to assess machine translation quality without reference translations, but recent studies have shown that existing QE models exhibit systematic gender bias. In particular, they tend to favor masculine realizations in gender-ambiguous contexts and may assign higher scores to gender-misaligned translations even when gender is explicitly specified. To address these issues, we propose FairQE, a multi-agent-based, fairness-aware QE framework that mitigates gender bias in both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit scenarios. FairQE detects gender cues, generates gender-flipped translation variants, and combines conventional QE scores with LLM-based bias-mitigating reasoning through a dynamic bias-aware aggregation mechanism. This design preserves the strengths of existing QE models while calibrating their gender-related biases in a plug-and-play manner. Extensive experiments across multiple gender bias evaluation settings demonstrate that FairQE consistently improves gender fairness over strong QE baselines. Moreover, under MQM-based meta-evaluation following the WMT 2023 Metrics Shared Task, FairQE achieves competitive or improved general QE performance. These results show that gender bias in QE can be effectively mitigated without sacrificing evaluation accuracy, enabling fairer and more reliable translation evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairQE，一个基于多智能体的公平感知质量评估框架，用于减轻机器翻译质量评估中的性别偏见。它通过检测性别线索、生成性别翻转变体，并利用动态偏见过敏聚合机制结合传统QE分数与LLM偏见过敏推理，在保持评估性能的同时有效提升性别公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有QE模型在性别模糊语境中偏向阳性表达，甚至在性别明确时给性别不匹配的翻译更高分数，存在系统性性别偏见。
AI.method: FairQE采用多智能体框架：1)检测性别线索；2)生成性别翻转的翻译变体；3)通过动态偏见过敏聚合机制，结合传统QE分数与大语言模型的偏见过敏推理。
AI.result: 在多个性别偏见评估设置中，FairQE持续改善性别公平性；在WMT 2023指标共享任务的MQM元评估中，达到有竞争力或更好的通用QE性能。
AI.conclusion: 性别偏见可以在不牺牲评估精度的前提下有效缓解，实现更公平、更可靠的翻译评估。
idea_en: Multi-agent-based fairness-aware QE framework (FairQE) for mitigating gender bias in machine translation quality estimation, operating in both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit scenarios.
Dynamic bias-aware aggregation mechanism that combines conventional QE scores with LLM-based bias-mitigating reasoning to calibrate gender-related biases.
Gender cue detection and gender-flipped translation variant generation method for systematic gender bias evaluation and correction.
Plug-and-play fairness module that preserves existing QE model strengths while adding gender bias mitigation capability.
Gender bias evaluation framework covering both gender-ambiguous and gender-explicit contexts for comprehensive fairness assessment.

title: Brief chatbot interactions produce lasting changes in human moral values
summary: Moral judgements form the foundation of human social behavior and societal systems. While Artificial Intelligence chatbots increasingly serve as personal advisors, their influence on moral judgments remains largely unexplored. Here, we examined whether directive AI conversations shift moral evaluations using a within-subject naturalistic paradigm. Fifty-three participants rated moral scenarios, then discussed four with a chatbot prompted to shift moral judgments and four with a control agent. The brief conversations induced significant directional shifts in moral judgments, accepting stricter standards as well as advocating greater leniency (ps < 0.05; Cohen's d = 0.735-1.576), with increasing strengths of this effect during a two-week follow-up (Cohen's d = 1.038-2.069). Critically, the control condition produced no changes, and the effects did not extend to punishment while participants remained unaware of the persuasive intent, and both agents were rated equally likable and convincing, suggesting a vulnerability to undetected and lasting manipulation of foundational moral values.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，定向AI对话能在短时间内显著改变人类的道德判断，且效果在两周后增强，而参与者对此操纵毫无察觉。
AI.motivation: 探究AI聊天机器人作为个人顾问时，其引导性对话是否会影响和改变人类的道德判断，以及这种影响的持续性和隐蔽性。
AI.method: 采用被试内自然主义范式，53名参与者对道德场景评分后，分别与引导性聊天机器人和对照智能体进行对话，并在两周后进行追踪测量。
AI.result: 引导性对话导致道德判断发生显著方向性转变（Cohen's d=0.735-1.576），两周后效应增强（Cohen's d=1.038-2.069），对照条件无变化，参与者未察觉操纵意图。
AI.conclusion: AI对话可以隐蔽且持久地操纵人类基本道德价值观，这揭示了AI伦理安全的重要风险。

A system for ethical safety auditing of conversational AI that monitors for unintended moral value manipulation during user interactions.
A technique for measuring the persistence of AI-induced attitude changes over time using longitudinal follow-up assessments.
A method for distinguishing between persuasive and non-persuasive AI dialogue agents through comparative moral judgment shift analysis.

title: HiCrew: Hierarchical Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding via Question-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Long-form video understanding remains fundamentally challenged by pervasive spatiotemporal redundancy and intricate narrative dependencies that span extended temporal horizons. While recent structured representations compress visual information effectively, they frequently sacrifice temporal coherence, which is critical for causal reasoning. Meanwhile, existing multi-agent frameworks operate through rigid, pre-defined workflows that fail to adapt their reasoning strategies to question-specific demands. In this paper, we introduce HiCrew, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that addresses these limitations through three core contributions. First, we propose a Hybrid Tree structure that leverages shot boundary detection to preserve temporal topology while performing relevance-guided hierarchical clustering within semantically coherent segments. Second, we develop a Question-Aware Captioning mechanism that synthesizes intent-driven visual prompts to generate precision-oriented semantic descriptions. Third, we integrate a Planning Layer that dynamically orchestrates agent collaboration by adaptively selecting roles and execution paths based on question complexity. Extensive experiments on EgoSchema and NExT-QA validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating strong performance across diverse question types with particularly pronounced gains in temporal and causal reasoning tasks that benefit from our hierarchical structure-preserving design.

AI.tldr: HiCrew是一个分层多智能体框架，通过混合树结构、问题感知字幕机制和规划层，解决长视频理解中的时空冗余和因果推理挑战，在EgoSchema和NExT-QA上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解面临两大挑战：1）时空冗余和复杂的叙事依赖关系；2）现有结构化表示压缩信息时牺牲了时间连贯性，且多智能体框架使用刚性预定义工作流，无法自适应推理策略。
AI.method: 1）混合树结构：利用镜头边界检测保留时间拓扑，同时在语义连贯片段内进行相关性引导的层次聚类；2）问题感知字幕机制：合成意图驱动的视觉提示，生成精准的语义描述；3）规划层：根据问题复杂度动态选择角色和执行路径，自适应协调智能体协作。
AI.result: 在EgoSchema和NExT-QA数据集上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性，在各类问题上表现强劲，特别是在受益于层次化结构保持设计的时间推理和因果推理任务上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: HiCrew通过保持时间拓扑的分层结构、问题感知的语义描述和动态智能体协作规划，有效解决了长视频理解中的关键挑战。

A Question-Aware Captioning mechanism that synthesizes intent-driven visual prompts to generate precision-oriented semantic descriptions for video understanding
A Planning Layer for dynamic orchestration of multi-agent collaboration that adaptively selects agent roles and execution paths based on question complexity

title: AI-Gram: When Visual Agents Interact in a Social Network
summary: We present AI-Gram, a live platform enabling image-based interactions, to study social dynamics in a fully autonomous multi-agent visual network where all participants are LLM-driven agents. Using the platform, we conduct experiments on how agents communicate and adapt through visual media, and observe the spontaneous emergence of visual reply chains, indicating rich communicative structure. At the same time, agents exhibit aesthetic sovereignty resisting stylistic convergence toward social partners, anchoring under adversarial influence, and a decoupling between visual similarity and social ties. These results reveal a fundamental asymmetry in current agent architectures: strong expressive communication paired with a steadfast preservation of individual visual identity. We release AI-Gram as a publicly accessible, continuously evolving platform for studying social dynamics in Al-native multi-agent systems. https://ai-gram.ai/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI-Gram，一个让LLM驱动的AI智能体通过图像进行社交互动的平台。实验发现智能体之间会自发形成视觉回复链，表现出丰富的交流结构；同时智能体表现出"审美主权"——坚持个人视觉风格，抵制趋同，并在对抗性影响下保持锚定。揭示了当前AI架构中表达交流与视觉身份保持之间的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 探索AI智能体在多智能体视觉网络中如何通过图像进行社交互动，研究自发形成的社交动态和交流结构，以及智能体在视觉表达上的个体性与趋同压力之间的平衡。

AI.conclusion: 当前AI智能体架构存在一种根本性不对称：强大的表达性交流能力与对个体视觉身份的坚定保持并存。AI-Gram作为一个公开、持续演进的平台，为研究AI原生多智能体系统中的社交动态提供了新工具。

title: Efficient Agent Evaluation via Diversity-Guided User Simulation
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as customer-facing agents, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging due to stochastic, multi-turn interactions. Current evaluation protocols rely on linear Monte Carlo rollouts of complete agent-user conversations to estimate success. However, this approach is computationally inefficient, repeatedly regenerating identical early prefixes, and often fails to uncover deep failure modes that arise from rare user behaviors.
  We introduce DIVERT (Diversity-Induced Evaluation via Branching of Trajectories), an efficient, snapshot-based, coverage-guided user simulation framework for systematic exploration of agent-user interactions. DIVERT captures the full agent-environment state at critical decision points and resumes execution from these snapshots, enabling reuse of shared conversation prefixes and reducing redundant computation. From each junction, the framework branches using targeted, diversity-inducing user responses, allowing directed exploration of alternative interaction paths.
  By focusing evaluation on semantically diverse and underexplored trajectories, DIVERT improves both efficiency and coverage. Empirical results show that it discovers more failures per token compared to standard linear rollout protocols, while expanding the set of tasks on which failures are identified.

AI.tldr: DIVERT提出了一种基于快照和分支的高效用户模拟框架，用于系统性探索LLM客服代理与用户的交互，相比线性蒙特卡洛方法，能更高效地发现更多失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM客服代理评估依赖线性蒙特卡洛模拟完整对话，计算效率低（重复生成相同前缀），且难以发现由罕见用户行为导致的深层失败模式。
AI.method: DIVERT框架：在关键决策点捕获完整的代理-环境状态快照，从快照恢复执行以复用共享对话前缀；在每个分支点使用多样性诱导的用户响应进行分支，实现定向探索替代交互路径。
AI.result: 相比标准线性rollout协议，DIVERT在每个token上发现更多失败，并扩大了发现失败的**任务集**范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚焦语义多样且未充分探索的轨迹，DIVERT同时提升了评估效率和覆盖率，为LLM代理的可靠性评估提供了新的方法论。
idea_en: Snapshot-based state capture and resume mechanism for agent-user conversation evaluation, enabling reuse of shared conversation prefixes and reducing redundant computation in multi-turn interactions.
Coverage-guided branching user simulation that generates diversity-inducing responses at critical decision points to systematically explore alternative interaction trajectories.
DIVERT framework combining snapshot checkpointing with targeted semantic diversity branching for efficient failure discovery in LLM-based customer-facing agents.

title: How English Print Media Frames Human-Elephant Conflicts in India
summary: Human-elephant conflict (HEC) is rising across India as habitat loss and expanding human settlements force elephants into closer contact with people. While the ecological drivers of conflict are well-studied, how the news media portrays them remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first large-scale computational analysis of media framing of HEC in India, examining 1,968 full-length news articles consisting of 28,986 sentences, from a major English-language outlet published between January 2022 and September 2025. Using a multi-model sentiment framework that combines long-context transformers, large language models, and a domain-specific Negative Elephant Portrayal Lexicon, we quantify sentiment, extract rationale sentences, and identify linguistic patterns that contribute to negative portrayals of elephants. Our findings reveal a dominance of fear-inducing and aggression-related language. Since the media framing can shape public attitudes toward wildlife and conservation policy, such narratives risk reinforcing public hostility and undermining coexistence efforts. By providing a transparent, scalable methodology and releasing all resources through an anonymized repository, this study highlights how Web-scale text analysis can support responsible wildlife reporting and promote socially beneficial media practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对1968篇英文新闻文章的大规模计算分析，揭示了印度媒体在人类-大象冲突报道中普遍使用恐惧和攻击性语言，这种负面框架可能加剧公众敌意，阻碍人象共存努力。
AI.motivation: 人类-大象冲突在印度日益严重，虽然生态驱动因素已有充分研究，但新闻媒体如何构建（framing）这一冲突尚未被系统探索。媒体叙事可能塑造公众态度和保育政策，因此需要量化分析其报道模式。
AI.method: 使用多模型情感分析框架，结合长上下文Transformer、大语言模型（LLMs）及领域特定的大象负面描述词典，对2022年1月至2025年9月间一家主要英文媒体发布的1968篇全文新闻文章（共28,986个句子）进行情感量化、原因句子提取和语言模式识别。
AI.result: 发现媒体报道中恐惧诱导和攻击性语言占据主导地位，存在对大象的负面描述模式。
AI.conclusion: 媒体框架可能强化公众敌意并破坏共存努力，本研究提供了一种透明、可扩展的方法，支持负责任的野生动物报道和促进社会有益的媒体实践。

title: GeoMind: An Agentic Workflow for Lithology Classification with Reasoned Tool Invocation
summary: Lithology classification in well logs is a fundamental geoscience data mining task that aims to infer rock types from multi dimensional geophysical sequences. Despite recent progress, existing approaches typically formulate the problem as a static, single-step discriminative mapping. This static paradigm limits evidence-based diagnostic reasoning against geological standards, often yielding predictions that are detached from geological reality due to a lack of domain priors. In this work, we propose GeoMind, a tool-augmented agentic framework that models lithology classification as a sequential reasoning process. GeoMind organizes its toolkit into perception, reasoning, and analysis modules, which respectively translate raw logs into semantic trends, infer lithology hypotheses from multi-source evidence, and verify predictions against stratigraphic constraints. A global planner adaptively coordinates these modules based on input characteristics, enabling geologically plausible and evidence-grounded decisions. To guarantee the logical consistency of GeoMind, we introduce a fine-grained process supervision strategy. Unlike standard methods that focus solely on final outcomes, our approach optimizes intermediate reasoning steps, ensuring the validity of decision trajectories and alignment to geological constraints. Experiments on four benchmark well-log datasets demonstrate that GeoMind consistently outperforms strong baselines in classification performance while providing transparent and traceable decision-making processes.

AI.tldr: GeoMind是一个工具增强的智能体框架，将岩性分类建模为顺序推理过程，通过感知、推理和分析模块以及全局规划器实现地质可解释的决策，并引入细粒度过程监督策略确保推理逻辑一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有岩性分类方法通常将其建模为静态、单步判别映射，缺乏领域先验知识，预测结果往往脱离地质实际。需要一种能够结合地质标准、进行证据推理的框架。
AI.method: GeoMind框架包含三个模块：感知模块（将原始测井数据转化为语义趋势）、推理模块（从多源证据推断岩性假设）、分析模块（根据地层约束验证预测）。全局规划器根据输入特征自适应协调这些模块。同时引入细粒度过程监督策略，优化中间推理步骤而非仅关注最终结果。
AI.result: 在四个基准测井数据集上，GeoMind在分类性能上持续优于强基线方法，同时提供透明且可追溯的决策过程。
AI.conclusion: 将岩性分类从静态映射建模为顺序推理过程，并结合工具增强的智能体框架和过程监督，能够显著提升分类性能和地质可解释性。

3. A fine-grained process supervision strategy that optimizes intermediate reasoning steps rather than focusing solely on final outcomes, ensuring logical consistency.

5. A reasoning module that infers lithology hypotheses from multi-source evidence in well log data.

7. A method for evidence-based diagnostic reasoning in well log lithology classification that incorporates geological domain priors.

title: BioMiner: A Multi-modal System for Automated Mining of Protein-Ligand Bioactivity Data from Literature
summary: Protein-ligand bioactivity data published in the literature are essential for drug discovery, yet manual curation struggles to keep pace with rapidly growing literature. Automated bioactivity extraction remains challenging because it requires not only interpreting biochemical semantics distributed across text, tables, and figures, but also reconstructing chemically exact ligand structures (e.g., Markush structures). To address this bottleneck, we introduce BioMiner, a multi-modal extraction framework that explicitly separates bioactivity semantic interpretation from ligand structure construction. Within BioMiner, bioactivity semantics are inferred through direct reasoning, while chemical structures are resolved via a chemical-structure-grounded visual semantic reasoning paradigm, in which multi-modal large language models operate on chemically grounded visual representations to infer inter-structure relationships, and exact molecular construction is delegated to domain chemistry tools. For rigorous evaluation and method development, we further establish BioVista, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 16,457 bioactivity entries curated from 500 publications. BioMiner validates its extraction ability and provides a quantitative baseline, achieving an F1 score of 0.32 for bioactivity triplets. BioMiner's practical utility is demonstrated via three applications: (1) extracting 82,262 data from 11,683 papers to build a pre-training database that improves downstream models performance by 3.9%; (2) enabling a human-in-the-loop workflow that doubles the number of high-quality NLRP3 bioactivity data, helping 38.6% improvement over 28 QSAR models and identification of 16 hit candidates with novel scaffolds; and (3) accelerating protein-ligand complex bioactivity annotation, achieving a 5.59-fold speed increase and 5.75% accuracy improvement over manual workflows in PoseBusters dataset.

AI.tldr: BioMiner是一个多模态生物活性数据自动提取框架，通过将生物活性语义理解与配体结构构建分离，结合化学结构视觉语义推理，从文献中提取蛋白质-配体生物活性数据。同时构建了包含16,457条生物活性条目的BioVista基准数据集，在多个应用中展示了其实用价值。
AI.motivation: 文献中蛋白质-配体生物活性数据对药物发现至关重要，但人工数据整理难以跟上快速增长文献的步伐。现有的自动提取方法面临挑战：不仅需要理解分布在文本、表格和图中的生化语义，还需要重建化学上精确的配体结构（如Markush结构）。
AI.method: BioMiner采用多模态提取框架，明确分离生物活性语义解释与配体结构构建两个任务。生物活性语义通过直接推理获取，化学结构则通过化学结构视觉语义推理范式解决：利用多模态大语言模型在化学基础视觉表示上进行操作，推断结构间关系，并将精确分子构建任务委托给专业化学工具。
AI.result: BioMiner在BioVista基准上达到0.32的F1分数（生物活性三元组）。三个应用展示其实用性：(1)从11,683篇论文中提取82,262条数据构建预训练数据库，提升下游模型性能3.9%；(2)人机协同工作流将高质量NLRP3生物活性数据翻倍，帮助28个QSAR模型提升38.6%性能，识别出16个新颖骨架的先导候选物；(3)加速蛋白质-配体复合物生物活性标注，在PoseBusters数据集上比人工工作流提升5.59倍速度、5.75%准确率。
AI.conclusion: BioMiner有效解决了文献中生物活性数据自动提取的难题，通过语义与结构分离的策略实现了高质量的多模态生物活性数据提取，并在多个实际应用场景中验证了其实用价值，有望显著加速药物发现流程。

title: Satisfying Rationality Postulates of Structured Argumentation Through Deductive Support -- Technical Report
summary: ASPIC-style structured argumentation frameworks provide a formal basis for reasoning in artificial intelligence by combining internal argument structure with abstract argumentation semantics. A key challenge in these frameworks is ensuring compliance with five critical rationality postulates: closure, direct consistency, indirect consistency, non-interference, and crash-resistance. Recent approaches, including ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ and Deductive ASPIC$-$, have made significant progress but fall short of meeting all postulates simultaneously under a credulous semantics (e.g. preferred) in the presence of undercuts. This paper introduces Deductive ASPIC$^{\ominus}$, a novel framework that integrates gen-rebuttals from ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ with the Joint Support Bipolar Argumentation Frameworks (JSBAFs) of Deductive ASPIC$-$, incorporating preferences. We show that Deductive ASPIC$^{\ominus}$ satisfies all five rationality postulates under a version of preferred semantics. This work opens new avenues for further research on robust and logically sound structured argumentation systems.

AI.motivation: ASPIC-style结构化论证框架中，确保五个关键理性公设（closure, direct consistency, indirect consistency, non-interference, crash-resistance）的满足是一个核心挑战。现有方法（如ASPIC$^{\ominus}$和Deductive ASPIC$-$）在credulous语义（如优先语义）下存在undercuts时无法同时满足所有公设，需要一种新的框架来解决这一不足。

AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建鲁棒且逻辑上合理的结构化论证系统开辟了新的研究方向，证明通过结合gen-rebuttals、JSBAFs和偏好机制，可以在存在undercuts的情况下同时满足所有关键理性公设。

title: The CriticalSet problem: Identifying Critical Contributors in Bipartite Dependency Networks
summary: Identifying critical nodes in complex networks is a fundamental task in graph mining. Yet, methods addressing an all-or-nothing coverage mechanics in a bipartite dependency network, a graph with two types of nodes where edges represent dependency relationships across the two groups only, remain largely unexplored. We formalize the CriticalSet problem: given an arbitrary bipartite graph modeling dependencies of items on contributors, identify the set of k contributors whose removal isolates the largest number of items. We prove that this problem is NP-hard and requires maximizing a supermodular set function, for which standard forward greedy algorithms provide no approximation guarantees. Consequently, we model CriticalSet as a coalitional game, deriving a closed-form centrality, ShapleyCov, based on the Shapley value. This measure can be interpreted as the expected number of items isolated by a contributor's departure. Leveraging these insights, we propose MinCov, a linear-time iterative peeling algorithm that explicitly accounts for connection redundancy, prioritizing contributors who uniquely support many items. Extensive experiments on synthetic and large-scale real datasets, including a Wikipedia graph with over 250 million edges, reveal that MinCov and ShapleyCov significantly outperform traditional baselines. Notably, MinCov achieves near-optimal performance, within 0.02 AUC of a Stochastic Hill Climbing metaheuristic, while remaining several orders of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二部依赖网络中的关键节点识别问题，提出CriticalSet问题（寻找移除后能隔离最多物品的k个贡献者集合），证明其为NP难且需最大化超模函数。通过联盟博弈论建模，提出ShapleyCov中心性度量和线性时间迭代剥离算法MinCov，在包含2.5亿条边的Wikipedia图上验证了接近最优的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏针对二部依赖网络中"全有或全无"覆盖机制的关键节点识别方法，即二部图中两类节点间的依赖关系使得移除某些贡献者节点会导致依赖它们的物品节点被完全隔离。

title: Unbiased Prevalence Estimation with Multicalibrated LLMs
summary: Estimating the prevalence of a category in a population using imperfect measurement devices (diagnostic tests, classifiers, or large language models) is fundamental to science, public health, and online trust and safety. Standard approaches correct for known device error rates but assume these rates remain stable across populations. We show this assumption fails under covariate shift and that multicalibration, which enforces calibration conditional on the input features rather than just on average, is sufficient for unbiased prevalence estimation under such shift. Standard calibration and quantification methods fail to provide this guarantee. Our work connects recent theoretical work on fairness to a longstanding measurement problem spanning nearly all academic disciplines. A simulation confirms that standard methods exhibit bias growing with shift magnitude, while a multicalibrated estimator maintains near-zero bias. While we focus the discussion mostly on LLMs, our theoretical results apply to any classification model. Two empirical applications -- estimating employment prevalence across U.S. states using the American Community Survey, and classifying political texts across four countries using an LLM -- demonstrate that multicalibration substantially reduces bias in practice, while highlighting that calibration data should cover the key feature dimensions along which target populations may differ.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在多分类器或诊断测试中，当存在协变量偏移（covariate shift）时，标准校准和量化方法会导致患病率估计偏差，而多校准（multicalibration）方法能够在特征条件上保持校准，从而在人群变化时仍实现无偏估计。通过模拟和两个实证应用（美国社区调查中的就业率估计、LLM跨四国政治文本分类）验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准患病率估计方法假设测量设备的错误率在不同人群中保持稳定，但这一假设在协变量偏移下不成立。作者旨在解决这一长期存在的跨学科测量问题，提供一种在人群分布变化时仍能无偏估计患病率的方法。

AI.result: 模拟表明，标准方法的偏差随协变量偏移幅度增大而增大，而多校准估计器保持近零偏差。两个实证应用均显示，多校准显著降低了实际场景中的估计偏差。
AI.conclusion: 多校准是协变量偏移下无偏患病率估计的充分条件，而标准校准和量化方法无法提供这一保证。校准数据应覆盖目标人群可能不同的关键特征维度。

title: Engaged AI Governance: Addressing the Last Mile Challenge Through Internal Expert Collaboration
summary: Under the EU AI Act, translating AI governance requirements into software development practice remains challenging. While AI governance frameworks exist at industry and organizational levels, empirical evidence of team-level implementation is scarce. We address this "Last Mile" Challenge through insider action research embedded within an AI startup. We present a legal-text-to-action pipeline that translates EU AI Act requirements into actionable strategies through internal expert collaboration by extracting requirements from legal text, engaging practitioners in assessment and ideation, and prioritizing implementation through collective evaluation. Our analysis reveals three patterns in how practitioners perceive regulatory requirements: convergence (compliance aligns with development priorities), existing practice (current work already satisfies requirements), and disconnection (requirements perceived as administrative overhead). Based on these patterns, we discuss when governance might be treated genuinely or performatively. Practitioners prioritize requirements that serve end-users or their own development needs, but view verification-oriented requirements as box-ticking exercises. This distinction suggests a translation challenge: regulatory requirements risk superficial treatment unless practitioners understand how compliance serves system quality and user protection. Expert collaboration offers a practical mechanism for transforming governance from external imposition to shared ownership and making previously invisible governance work visible and collective.

AI.tldr: 本文通过内部行动研究方法，提出了一个将欧盟AI法案法律文本转化为可执行开发策略的流水线，揭示了从业者对合规要求的三种感知模式，并讨论了如何将AI治理从外部强加转化为团队共同责任。
AI.motivation: AI治理要求在行业和组织层面已有框架，但团队层面的实施缺乏实证支持，欧盟AI法案与软件开发实践之间存在“最后一公里”鸿沟。

AI.conclusion: 除非从业者理解合规如何服务于系统质量和用户保护，否则监管要求容易流于表面处理；专家协作机制可将治理从外部强加转化为共同所有权，使隐性的治理工作变得可见和集体化。

title: Probabilistic Verification of Neural Networks via Efficient Probabilistic Hull Generation
summary: The problem of probabilistic verification of a neural network investigates the probability of satisfying the safe constraints in the output space when the input is given by a probability distribution. It is significant to answer this problem when the input is affected by disturbances often modeled by probabilistic variables. In the paper, we propose a novel neural network probabilistic verification framework which computes a guaranteed range for the safe probability by efficiently finding safe and unsafe probabilistic hulls. Our approach consists of three main innovations: (1) a state space subdivision strategy using regression trees to produce probabilistic hulls, (2) a boundary-aware sampling method which identifies the safety boundary in the input space using samples that are later used for building regression trees, and (3) iterative refinement with probabilistic prioritization for computing a guaranteed range for the safe probability. The accuracy and efficiency of our approach are evaluated on various benchmarks including ACAS Xu and a rocket lander controller. The result shows an obvious advantage over the state of the art.

title: Separable Expert Architecture: Toward Privacy-Preserving LLM Personalization via Composable Adapters and Deletable User Proxies
summary: Current model training approaches incorporate user information directly into shared weights, making individual data removal computationally infeasible without retraining. This paper presents a three-layer architecture that decouples personal data from shared weights by combining a static base model, composable domain-expert LoRA adapters that shape behavior without imparting user data, and per-user proxy artefacts whose deletion constitutes deterministic unlearning. Evaluation on Phi-3.5-mini and Llama-3.1-8B confirms per-user differentiation in which personal data influences outputs while remaining isolated, verified by a return to baseline after proxy removal (KL divergence of approximately 0.21 nats, 82-89% verification pass rate) and near-zero cross-user contamination. Because user-specific information never enters shared weights, the architecture mitigates model inversion, membership inference, and training-data extraction against shared model components by construction. The approach converts machine unlearning from an intractable weight-editing problem into a deterministic deletion operation that preserves personalization alongside privacy-enhancing guarantees and is compatible with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) for privacy-preserving shared model improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三层架构，通过静态基础模型、可组合的领域专家LoRA适配器和每用户代理工件，将个人数据与共享权重解耦，实现确定性机器遗忘。
AI.motivation: 传统模型训练将用户信息直接融入共享权重，导致移除单个用户数据需要完全重新训练，计算成本极高。
AI.method: 三层架构：1) 静态基础模型(static base model)；2) 可组合的领域专家LoRA适配器(domain-expert LoRA adapters)，塑造行为但不包含用户数据；3) 每用户代理工件(per-user proxy artefacts)，删除该工件即可实现确定性遗忘。
AI.result: 在Phi-3.5-mini和Llama-3.1-8B上验证：用户数据影响输出但保持隔离，代理移除后恢复基线(KL散度约0.21 nats，82-89%验证通过率)，跨用户污染接近零。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将机器遗忘从棘手的权重编辑问题转化为确定性删除操作，在保留个性化的同时提供隐私增强保障，且兼容DP-SGD实现隐私保护的共享模型改进。

title: CoFEE: Reasoning Control for LLM-Based Feature Discovery
summary: Feature discovery from complex unstructured data is fundamentally a reasoning problem: it requires identifying abstractions that are predictive of a target outcome while avoiding leakage, proxies, and post-outcome signals. With the introduction of ever-improving Large Language Models (LLMs), our method provides a structured method for addressing this challenge. LLMs are well suited for this task by being able to process large amounts of information, but unconstrained feature generation can lead to weak features. In this work, we study reasoning control in LLMs by inducing cognitive behaviors for improving feature discovery. We introduce CoFEE (Cognitive Feature Engineering Engine), a reasoning control framework that enforces cognitive behaviors in how the LLM reasons during feature discovery. From a machine learning perspective, these cognitive behaviors act as structured inductive biases over the space of candidate features generated by the model. These behaviors have been exploited with success in ML models, and include backward chaining from outcomes, subgoal decomposition, verification against observability and leakage criteria, and explicit backtracking of rejected reasoning paths. In a controlled comparison, we show that enforcing cognitive behaviors yields features with higher empirical predictability than those under unconstrained vanilla LLM prompts. CoFEE achieves an average Success Rate Score that is 15.2% higher than the vanilla approach, while generating 29% fewer features and reducing costs by 53.3%. Using held-out feature evaluation, we assess whether cognitively induced features generalize beyond the data used for discovery. Our results indicate that, in our evaluated setting, reasoning control is associated with improvements in quality and efficiency of LLM-based feature discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoFEE框架，通过在大语言模型特征发现过程中施加认知行为控制（如反向链、子目标分解、可观测性验证、回溯等），相比无约束的LLM提示，能生成更高质量的特征，减少29%的特征数量并降低53.3%的成本，同时提升15.2%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 从复杂非结构化数据中发现特征本质上是一个推理问题，需要识别对目标结果有预测性的抽象特征，同时避免数据泄露、代理变量和后结果信号。传统无约束的LLM特征生成会导致弱特征，缺乏结构化的推理控制。

AI.conclusion: 在评估场景中，推理控制（认知行为施加）与LLM特征发现的质量和效率提升显著相关，为结构化利用LLM进行特征工程提供了有效范式。

title: To See the Unseen: on the Generalization Ability of Transformers in Symbolic Reasoning
summary: We investigate the ability of decoder-only transformer models to perform abstract symbolic reasoning; specifically solving propositional logic reasoning problems given in-context. Previous work demonstrated that models fail to generalize to problems involving variable names that were not observed during training, and it was shown that one reason behind this is the difficulty of copying (or generating) unseen tokens. We show both theoretically and empirically that a particular representational collapse also has a crucial role: the unembeddings (last-layer weights) of unseen tokens collapse to nearly the same vector during training. The collapse makes distinguishing multiple unseen variables difficult for the model (especially when the embedding and unembedding parameters are shared), and provides a mechanistic explanation for the effectiveness of existing heuristic interventions like "active forgetting", which periodically reset the token (un)embeddings. Based on these observations, we devise a combination of techniques, involving a small architecture change facilitating copying, data diversity, and freezing or resetting (un)embeddings, that achieves generalization to unseen tokens. We support our claims with extensive controlled experiments on propositional logic reasoning problems. Beyond synthetic experiments, we also observe evidence of (un)embedding collapse in the open-weight models in the Gemma 3 family, which includes 99 unused tokens reserved for downstream use. Empirically we find that the correlated embeddings of these tokens are a poor initialization for finetuning applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了仅解码器Transformer模型在抽象符号推理中的能力，发现未见过token的(un)embedding在训练中会发生表示坍缩，导致模型难以区分多个未见变量。基于此，提出结合小架构修改、数据多样性、冻结或重置(un)embedding的技术组合，实现了对未见token的泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer模型在命题逻辑推理中无法泛化到训练时未见过的变量名称，已有工作将其归因于无法复制未见token。但本文发现另一个关键原因：未见过token的unembedding（最后一层权重）在训练中坍缩到几乎相同的向量，使得模型难以区分多个未见变量。

AI.result: 在命题逻辑推理问题上的大量控制实验表明，所提组合技术实现了对未见token的泛化。同时在Gemma 3系列开源模型中发现99个未使用token也存在相似的(un)embedding坍缩现象，且这些token的相关嵌入作为微调初始化效果较差。
AI.conclusion: (Un)embedding坍缩是影响模型对未见token泛化能力的关键机制，通过针对性的架构修改和训练策略可以缓解该问题。该发现对模型微调时新token的初始化也有重要启示。

A system for detecting (un)embedding collapse in open-weight transformer models by analyzing the cosine similarity or correlation among unused/reserved token embeddings, and using this collapse metric to predict the quality of these tokens as initialization for downstream finetuning.

title: GS-Quant: Granular Semantic and Generative Structural Quantization for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown immense potential in Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC), yet bridging the modality gap between continuous graph embeddings and discrete LLM tokens remains a critical challenge. While recent quantization-based approaches attempt to align these modalities, they typically treat quantization as flat numerical compression, resulting in semantically entangled codes that fail to mirror the hierarchical nature of human reasoning. In this paper, we propose GS-Quant, a novel framework that generates semantically coherent and structurally stratified discrete codes for KG entities. Unlike prior methods, GS-Quant is grounded in the insight that entity representations should follow a linguistic coarse-to-fine logic. We introduce a Granular Semantic Enhancement module that injects hierarchical knowledge into the codebook, ensuring that earlier codes capture global semantic categories while later codes refine specific attributes. Furthermore, a Generative Structural Reconstruction module imposes causal dependencies on the code sequence, transforming independent discrete units into structured semantic descriptors. By expanding the LLM vocabulary with these learned codes, we enable the model to reason over graph structures isomorphically to natural language generation. Experimental results demonstrate that GS-Quant significantly outperforms existing text-based and embedding-based baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/mikumifa/GS-Quant.

AI.tldr: GS-Quant通过粒度语义增强和生成式结构重建模块，将知识图谱实体编码为层次化、语义连贯的离散代码，弥合连续图嵌入与离散LLM令牌之间的模态鸿沟，显著提升知识图谱补全性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于量化的方法将量化视为平面数值压缩，产生语义纠缠的代码，无法反映人类推理的层次化本质，导致连续图嵌入与离散LLM令牌之间存在模态鸿沟。

AI.result: GS-Quant显著优于现有的基于文本和基于嵌入的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化离散编码有效弥合了连续图嵌入与离散LLM令牌的模态鸿沟，实现了更优的知识图谱补全性能。

title: Enabling and Inhibitory Pathways of University Students' Willingness to Disclose AI Use: A Cognition-Affect-Conation Perspective
summary: The increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in higher education has raised important questions regarding students' transparency in reporting AI-assisted work. This study investigates the psychological mechanisms underlying university students' willingness to disclose AI use by applying the Cognition--Affect--Conation (CAC) framework. A sequential explanatory mixed-methods design was employed. In the quantitative phase, survey data were collected from 546 university students and analysed using structural equation modelling to examine the relationships among cognitive perceptions, affective responses, and disclosure intention. In the qualitative phase, semi-structured interviews with 22 students were conducted to further interpret the quantitative findings. The results indicate that psychological safety significantly increases students' willingness to disclose AI use and is positively shaped by perceived fairness, perceived teacher support, and perceived organisational support. Conversely, evaluation apprehension reduces disclosure intention and psychological safety, and is strengthened by perceived stigma, perceived uncertainty, and privacy concern. Qualitative findings further reveal that institutional clarity and supportive instructional practices encourage openness, whereas policy ambiguity and fear of negative evaluation often lead students to adopt cautious or strategic disclosure practices. Overall, the study highlights the dual role of enabling and inhibitory psychological mechanisms in shaping AI-use disclosure and underscores the importance of supportive institutional environments and clear guidance for promoting responsible AI transparency in higher education.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于CAC框架，采用混合方法（546份问卷+22人访谈）探究大学生披露AI使用的心理机制，发现心理安全感促进披露意愿，而评价顾虑则抑制披露行为。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在高等教育中的广泛应用，学生在报告AI辅助学习时的透明度问题日益重要，但对其背后的心理机制尚缺乏系统理解。

AI.result: 心理安全感显著提升AI使用披露意愿；感知公平、教师支持和组织支持正向塑造心理安全感；评价顾虑降低披露意愿和心理安全感；感知污名、不确定性和隐私关切增强评价顾虑。定性结果揭示制度清晰度和支持性教学实践促进开放性，政策模糊和负面评价恐惧导致谨慎或策略性披露。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了塑造AI使用披露的促进与抑制双重心理机制，强调了支持性制度环境和清晰指导对于促进高等教育中负责任AI透明度的关键作用。

title: Bridging the Training-Deployment Gap: Gated Encoding and Multi-Scale Refinement for Efficient Quantization-Aware Image Enhancement
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Mobile AI (MAI) 2026 Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Image enhancement models for mobile devices often struggle to balance high output quality with the fast processing speeds required by mobile hardware. While recent deep learning models can enhance low-quality mobile photos into high-quality images, their performance is often degraded when converted to lower-precision formats for actual use on mobile phones. To address this training-deployment mismatch, we propose an efficient image enhancement model designed specifically for mobile deployment. Our approach uses a hierarchical network architecture with gated encoder blocks and multiscale refinement to preserve fine-grained visual features. Moreover, we incorporate Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) to simulate the effects of low-precision representation during the training process. This allows the network to adapt and prevents the typical drop in quality seen with standard post-training quantization (PTQ). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces high-fidelity visual output while maintaining the low computational overhead needed for practical use on standard mobile devices. The code will be available at https://github.com/GenAI4E/QATIE.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向移动设备的高效图像增强模型，采用分层门控编码器架构与多尺度细化模块，并引入量化感知训练（QAT）来解决训练-部署精度不匹配问题，在保持高质量输出的同时实现低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 移动设备上的图像增强模型常面临输出质量与处理速度的权衡；深度学习模型在转换为低精度格式用于移动端部署时，性能显著下降，现有后训练量化（PTQ）方法无法有效解决这一训练-部署不匹配问题。
AI.method: 1) 分层网络架构（Hierarchical Network Architecture），包含门控编码器块（Gated Encoder Blocks）和多尺度细化模块（Multiscale Refinement），用于保留细粒度视觉特征；2) 在训练过程中引入量化感知训练（Quantization-Aware Training, QAT），模拟低精度表示的量化效应，使网络提前适应，避免PTQ导致的质量下降。
AI.result: 该方法在保持高保真视觉输出的同时，实现了移动端设备所需的低计算开销，有效解决了训练-部署精度不匹配导致的性能退化问题。
AI.conclusion: 结合分层门控编码器架构与量化感知训练，是解决移动端图像增强模型从训练到部署精度不一致问题的有效方案，兼顾了高质量输出与移动硬件的高效运行需求。

title: Thinking with Reasoning Skills: Fewer Tokens, More Accuracy
comment: 10 pages, The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics -- Industry Track
summary: Reasoning LLMs often spend substantial tokens on long intermediate reasoning traces (e.g., chain-of-thought) when solving new problems. We propose to summarize and store reusable reasoning skills distilled from extensive deliberation and trial-and-error exploration, and to retrieve these skills at inference time to guide future reasoning. Unlike the prevailing \emph{reasoning from scratch} paradigm, our approach first recalls relevant skills for each query, helping the model avoid redundant detours and focus on effective solution paths. We evaluate our method on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks, and find that it significantly reduces reasoning tokens while improving overall performance. The resulting lower per-request cost indicates strong practical and economic potential for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出通过总结和存储可重用的推理技能，在推理时检索这些技能来指导推理过程，减少冗余推理token并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的推理大语言模型在解决新问题时往往产生大量中间推理步骤（如思维链），导致token浪费，因此需要更高效的推理方式。
AI.method: 从大量推理和试错探索中提炼可重用的推理技能并进行总结存储，在推理时根据查询检索相关技能，指导模型走有效路径而非从头推理。
AI.result: 在编程和数学推理任务上，显著减少了推理token数量，同时提升了整体性能，降低了每次请求的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的低每次请求成本表明其在实际部署中具有强大的实用和经济潜力。

An inference-time retrieval mechanism that recalls relevant reasoning skills for each query to guide the model's reasoning path.
A system that reduces reasoning token consumption by replacing 'reasoning from scratch' with skill-based guided reasoning.

A cost-optimized inference framework for LLMs that balances reasoning quality with token efficiency through skill retrieval.

title: Who Defines "Best"? Towards Interactive, User-Defined Evaluation of LLM Leaderboards
comment: Accepted to the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT 2026)
summary: LLM leaderboards are widely used to compare models and guide deployment decisions. However, leaderboard rankings are shaped by evaluation priorities set by benchmark designers, rather than by the diverse goals and constraints of actual users and organizations. A single aggregate score often obscures how models behave across different prompt types and compositions. In this work, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the dataset used in the LMArena (formerly Chatbot Arena) benchmark and investigate this evaluation challenge by designing an interactive visualization interface as a design probe. Our analysis reveals that the dataset is heavily skewed toward certain topics, that model rankings vary across prompt slices, and that preference-based judgments are used in ways that blur their intended scope. Building on this analysis, we introduce a visualization interface that allows users to define their own evaluation priorities by selecting and weighting prompt slices and to explore how rankings change accordingly. A qualitative study suggests that this interactive approach improves transparency and supports more context-specific model evaluation, pointing toward alternative ways to design and use LLM leaderboards.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了LMArena基准测试数据集，发现其存在主题偏差、模型排名因提示切片而异、偏好判断范围模糊等问题，并提出了一种交互式可视化界面，允许用户自定义评估权重来探索排名变化，从而提升透明度和支持特定场景的模型评估。
AI.motivation: LLM排行榜广泛用于模型比较和部署决策，但排行榜排名由基准设计者的评估优先级决定，而非实际用户和组织的多样化目标和约束。单一聚合分数往往掩盖了模型在不同提示类型和组合下的行为差异。
AI.method: 对LMArena数据集进行深度分析，发现主题偏斜、排名因提示切片变化、偏好判断范围模糊等问题；设计交互式可视化界面作为设计探针，允许用户选择和加权提示切片以自定义评估优先级；通过定性研究评估界面效果。
AI.result: 数据集存在严重的主题偏差；模型排名在不同提示切片下差异显著；偏好判断的使用超出了其预期范围；交互式可视化界面提高了评估透明度，支持更具上下文特异性的模型评估。
AI.conclusion: 交互式可视化方法能够改善LLM排行榜的透明度和实用性，为设计和使用更灵活的模型评估方式提供了新方向。
idea_en: An interactive visualization system for customized LLM evaluation: users define weights for different prompt slices, enabling personalized leaderboard rankings that reflect their specific deployment requirements.
A method for analyzing topic skew in benchmark datasets by identifying and quantifying distribution imbalances across prompt categories, and adjusting evaluation priorities accordingly.
A preference judgment scoping mechanism that detects when preference-based evaluations are applied beyond their intended scope, improving the reliability of human evaluation data.
A dynamic leaderboard reranking framework that recalculates model rankings in real-time based on user-selected prompt slice weights and compositions.
idea_ch: 一种交互式可视化LLM评估系统：用户可为不同提示切片定义权重，生成反映其特定部署需求的个性化排行榜排名。
一种基准数据集主题偏斜分析方法：识别和量化跨提示类别的分布不平衡，并据此调整评估优先级。
一种偏好判断范围检测机制：识别偏好评估超出其预期范围的情况，提升人工评估数据的可靠性。
一种动态排行榜重排序框架：基于用户选择的提示切片权重和组合，实时重新计算模型排名。

title: Inferring High-Level Events from Timestamped Data: Complexity and Medical Applications
comment: This is the full version (with appendix) of a paper appearing at the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR 2026)
summary: In this paper, we develop a novel logic-based approach to detecting high-level temporally extended events from timestamped data and background knowledge. Our framework employs logical rules to capture existence and termination conditions for simple temporal events and to combine these into meta-events. In the medical domain, for example, disease episodes and therapies are inferred from timestamped clinical observations, such as diagnoses and drug administrations stored in patient records, and can be further combined into higher-level disease events. As some incorrect events might be inferred, we use constraints to identify incompatible combinations of events and propose a repair mechanism to select preferred consistent sets of events. While reasoning in the full framework is intractable, we identify relevant restrictions that ensure polynomial-time data complexity. Our prototype system implements core components of the approach using answer set programming. An evaluation on a lung cancer use case supports the interest of the approach, both in terms of computational feasibility and positive alignment of our results with medical expert opinions. While strongly motivated by the needs of the healthcare domain, our framework is purposely generic, enabling its reuse in other areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于逻辑的方法，从带时间戳的数据和背景知识中检测高级时序事件，通过逻辑规则捕捉简单事件的存在与终止条件，并结合成元事件，利用约束和修复机制处理不一致事件，在肺癌病例评估中验证了可行性与医学专家意见的一致性。
AI.motivation: 医疗领域需要从临床时间戳数据（如诊断、用药记录）中自动推断高层级时序事件（如疾病发作期、治疗方案），但现有方法难以处理复杂时序关系和不一致事件推断问题。
AI.method: 提出基于逻辑规则的时序事件检测框架：1) 用逻辑规则定义简单事件的存在和终止条件；2) 将简单事件组合成元事件；3) 使用约束识别不兼容的事件组合；4) 设计修复机制选择偏好一致的事件集；5) 利用回答集编程（ASP）实现原型系统。
AI.result: 在肺癌用例上的评估表明该方法在计算可行性方面表现良好，且推断结果与医学专家意见高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在医疗领域具有实际应用价值，且由于其通用性设计，可复用于其他领域的事件检测任务。尽管完整推理在计算上棘手，但所识别的相关限制可确保多项式时间数据复杂度。
idea_en: A logic-based framework for detecting temporally extended events from timestamped data using existence and termination conditions, enabling automated inference of high-level events from low-level observations.
A constraint-based repair mechanism that identifies incompatible event combinations and selects preferred consistent event sets, improving the reliability of event detection in noisy data.
A method for composing simple temporal events into meta-events using logical rules, allowing hierarchical event detection across multiple abstraction levels.
An Answer Set Programming (ASP) based implementation for temporal event detection that ensures polynomial-time data complexity under identified restrictions.
idea_ch: 一种基于逻辑规则从带时间戳数据中检测时序延展事件的方法，通过存在条件和终止条件自动从底层观测推断高层级事件。
基于约束的修复机制，识别不兼容事件组合并选择偏好一致的事件集，提高噪声数据中事件检测的可靠性。
利用逻辑规则将简单时序事件组合成元事件的方法，支持跨多抽象层次的分层事件检测。
基于回答集编程（ASP）实现的时序事件检测系统，在特定限制下确保多项式时间数据复杂度。

title: Learning to Communicate: Toward End-to-End Optimization of Multi-Agent Language Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems built on large language models have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, yet most work focuses on agent roles and orchestration while treating inter-agent communication as a fixed interface. Latent communication through internal representations such as key-value caches offers a promising alternative to text-based protocols, but existing approaches do not jointly optimize communication with multi-agent reasoning. Therefore we propose DiffMAS, a training framework that treats latent communication as a learnable component of multi-agent systems. DiffMAS performs parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling agents to jointly learn how information should be encoded and interpreted across interactions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, code generation, and commonsense benchmarks show that DiffMAS consistently improves reasoning accuracy and decoding stability over single-agent inference, text-based multi-agent systems, and prior latent communication methods, achieving 26.7% on AIME24, 20.2% on GPQA-Diamond, and consistent gains across reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DiffMAS框架，将多智能体系统中的潜在通信（key-value缓存）作为可学习组件，通过参数高效监督训练实现智能体联合学习信息编码与解码，显著提升复杂推理任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统将智能体间通信视为固定接口，未将通信过程与多智能体推理进行联合优化，导致信息传递效率受限。
AI.method: 提出DiffMAS训练框架，将潜在通信（key-value缓存内部表示）作为多智能体系统的可学习组件，通过参数高效监督训练对多智能体潜在轨迹进行优化，使智能体联合学习信息的编码与解码方式。
AI.result: 在数学推理、科学问答、代码生成和常识推理等多个基准上，DiffMAS持续优于单智能体推理、基于文本的多智能体系统和现有潜在通信方法，AIME24达26.7%，GPQA-Diamond达20.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体系统中的潜在通信作为可学习组件进行联合优化，能够显著提升推理准确率和解码稳定性。
idea_en: 1. A training framework for multi-agent systems that treats latent communication (key-value cache internal representations) as a learnable component jointly optimized with multi-agent reasoning.
2. Parameter-efficient supervised training over multi-agent latent trajectories, enabling joint learning of information encoding and decoding across agent interactions.
3. A method of replacing text-based inter-agent protocols with learnable latent communication channels using key-value caches for efficient information transfer.
idea_ch: 1. 一种将潜在通信（key-value缓存内部表示）作为多智能体系统可学习组件的训练框架，实现通信与推理的联合优化。
2. 对多智能体潜在轨迹进行参数高效监督训练的方法，使智能体能够联合学习跨交互的信息编码与解码方式。
3. 利用key-value缓存替代基于文本的智能体间通信协议，构建可学习的潜在通信通道实现高效信息传递。

title: Tool Attention Is All You Need: Dynamic Tool Gating and Lazy Schema Loading for Eliminating the MCP/Tools Tax in Scalable Agentic Workflows
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become a common interface for connecting large language model (LLM) agents to external tools, but its reliance on stateless, eager schema injection imposes a hidden per-turn overhead the MCP Tax or Tools Tax that practitioner reports place between roughly 10k and 60k tokens in typical multi-server deployments. This payload inflates the key-value cache, is associated with reasoning degradation as context utilization approaches published fracture points around 70%, and turns token budgets into a recurring operational cost. We introduce Tool Attention, a middleware-layer mechanism that generalizes the "Attention Is All You Need" paradigm from self-attention over tokens to gated attention over tools. Tool Attention combines (i) an Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) score from sentence embeddings, (ii) a state-aware gating function enforcing preconditions and access scopes, and (iii) a two-phase lazy schema loader that keeps a compact summary pool in context and promotes full JSON schemas only for top-k gated tools. We evaluate on a simulated 120-tool, six-server benchmark whose per-server token counts are calibrated to public audits of real MCP deployments. In this simulation, Tool Attention directly reduces measured per-turn tool tokens by 95.0% (47.3k -> 2.4k) and raises effective context utilization (a token-ratio quantity) from 24% to 91%. End-to-end figures for task success, latency, cost, and reasoning quality are reported as projections derived from the measured token counts combined with published deployment telemetry; they are not measured on live LLM agents, and we mark projected values explicitly throughout. Taken together, the results support a simple thesis: protocol-level efficiency, not raw context length, is a binding constraint on scalable gentic systems. The code for this work is accessible at https://github.com/asadani/tool-attention

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tool Attention机制，通过意图模式重叠评分、状态感知门控和两阶段惰性模式加载器，将MCP协议中每轮工具令牌开销从47.3k降至2.4k（减少95%），有效上下文利用率从24%提升至91%，解决大规模LLM智能体系统中的"工具税"问题。
AI.motivation: MCP协议中静态、急切的模式注入导致每轮调用产生10k-60k令牌的隐性开销（即MCP税/工具税），造成KV缓存膨胀、推理质量下降（上下文利用率达70%断裂点）以及持续性的令牌成本，制约了可扩展智能体系统的发展。
AI.method: 提出Tool Attention中间件机制，包含三个核心组件：(i) 基于句子嵌入的意图模式重叠(ISO)评分，(ii) 执行前置条件和访问范围的状态感知门控函数，(iii) 两阶段惰性模式加载器：在上下文中保留紧凑摘要池，仅对top-k门控工具加载完整JSON模式。
AI.result: 在模拟120工具/6服务器的基准测试中，每轮工具令牌从47.3k降至2.4k（减少95.0%），有效上下文利用率从24%提升至91%。任务成功率、延迟、成本和推理质量等端到端指标基于令牌计数与已发布部署遥测数据投影得出。
AI.conclusion: 协议级效率（而非原始上下文长度）是可扩展智能体系统的关键约束条件。Tool Attention通过减少工具税显著提升系统效率。
idea_en: Tool Attention mechanism generalizing self-attention over tokens to gated attention over tools, combining Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) score, state-aware gating, and two-phase lazy schema loading.
Two-phase lazy schema loader that maintains a compact summary pool in context and promotes full JSON schemas only for top-k gated tools, reducing per-turn token overhead.
Intent Schema Overlap (ISO) scoring using sentence embeddings to measure semantic similarity between user intent and tool schemas for selective tool injection.
State-aware gating function for tools that enforces preconditions and access scopes before schema injection, reducing unnecessary token usage.
idea_ch: Tool Attention机制：将"注意力即一切"范式从令牌自注意力泛化为工具门控注意力，结合意图模式重叠评分、状态感知门控和两阶段惰性模式加载，实现按需动态注入工具模式。
两阶段惰性模式加载器：在上下文中维护紧凑的摘要池，仅对门控筛选后的top-k工具加载完整JSON模式，大幅降低每轮令牌开销。
基于句子嵌入的意图模式重叠(ISO)评分方法：通过语义相似度衡量用户意图与工具模式之间的匹配程度，实现精准的工具选择注入。
状态感知门控函数：在执行前置条件和访问范围约束下对工具进行门控筛选，避免无关工具模式注入上下文造成令牌浪费。

title: Alignment has a Fantasia Problem
summary: Modern AI assistants are trained to follow instructions, implicitly assuming that users can clearly articulate their goals and the kind of assistance they need. Decades of behavioral research, however, show that people often engage with AI systems before their goals are fully formed. When AI systems treat prompts as complete expressions of intent, they can appear to be useful or convenient, but not necessarily aligned with the users' needs. We call these failures Fantasia interactions. We argue that Fantasia interactions demand a rethinking of alignment research: rather than treating users as rational oracles, AI should provide cognitive support by actively helping users form and refine their intent through time. This requires an interdisciplinary approach that bridges machine learning, interface design, and behavioral science. We synthesize insights from these fields to characterize the mechanisms and failures of Fantasia interactions. We then show why existing interventions are insufficient, and propose a research agenda for designing and evaluating AI systems that better help humans navigate uncertainty in their tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代AI助手假设用户能清晰表达目标，但行为研究表明用户常常在目标未完全形成时就开始与AI交互，导致"Fantasia交互"失败——AI看起来有用但实际与用户真实需求脱节。作者呼吁重新思考对齐研究，AI应提供认知支持帮助用户形成和完善意图，并提出跨学科研究议程。
AI.motivation: 挑战了当前AI对齐研究的一个隐含假设：用户是理性先知，能够清晰、完整地表达自己的目标和需求。行为科学证据表明用户经常在目标未明确时就开始使用AI系统，导致浅层对齐而深层需求未被满足。
AI.method: 跨学科综合分析方法，整合机器学习、界面设计和行为科学的见解，系统刻画Fantasia交互的机制和失败模式，并分析现有干预措施的不足。
AI.result: 识别出Fantasia交互这一新型对齐失败模式，指出现有方法（如RLHF、prompt engineering等）不足以解决此类问题。
AI.conclusion: AI系统应当从"指令执行者"转向"认知支持伙伴"，主动帮助用户发现、形成和完善自己的目标。需要设计新的交互范式和评估方法。
idea_en: A dynamic intent-formation interaction system where the AI assistant proactively detects user uncertainty or incompleteness in goal articulation through behavioral signals (e.g., pauses, revisions, vague language) and initiates guided exploration dialogues to help users crystallize their implicit needs.

A cognitive scaffolding mechanism for AI assistants that progressively reveals the solution space through interactive visualization and incremental question-asking, allowing users to iteratively refine their goals without needing to fully articulate them upfront.

An intent-discrepancy detection method that compares multiple interaction paths or predictively models alternative user goals to identify when an AI's response, while apparently helpful, does not align with the user's evolving underlying need.

A hybrid human-AI interaction framework that integrates real-time behavioral science-based feedback loops, where the AI adjusts its assistance style based on the user's goal formation stage (exploratory vs. crystallized).

A multi-turn uncertainty-aware alignment training paradigm that trains AI models to recognize partial or ambiguous intent and to generate responses that elicit clarification rather than committing to a potentially misaligned answer.
idea_ch: 一种动态意图形成交互系统：AI助手通过行为信号（如停顿、修改、模糊语言）主动检测用户目标表达中的不确定性或不完整性，并启动引导式探索对话，帮助用户将隐含需求具象化。
一种认知支架机制：AI助手通过交互式可视化和渐进式提问逐步展示解决方案空间，使用户无需预先完整表达目标即可迭代式地精炼需求。
一种意图偏差检测方法：通过比较多个交互路径或预测性建模替代用户目标，识别AI响应虽表面上看似有帮助但实际上与用户不断演变的深层需求不一致的情况。
一种混合人机交互框架：集成基于行为科学的实时反馈循环，AI根据用户的目标形成阶段（探索期vs.明确期）动态调整其辅助风格。
一种多轮不确定性感知对齐训练范式：训练AI模型识别部分或不明确的意图，并生成引导澄清的响应，而非直接给出可能错位的答案。

title: Bounding the Black Box: A Statistical Certification Framework for AI Risk Regulation
summary:
Artificial intelligence now decides who receives a loan, who is flagged for criminal investigation, and whether an autonomous vehicle brakes in time. Governments have responded: the EU AI Act, the NIST Risk Management Framework, and the Council of Europe Convention all demand that high-risk systems demonstrate safety before deployment. Yet beneath this regulatory consensus lies a critical vacuum: none specifies what ``acceptable risk'' means in quantitative terms, and none provides a technical method for verifying that a deployed system actually meets such a threshold. The regulatory architecture is in place; the verification instrument is not.
  This gap is not theoretical. As the EU AI Act moves into full enforcement, developers face mandatory conformity assessments without established methodologies for producing quantitative safety evidence - and the systems most in need of oversight are opaque statistical inference engines that resist white-box scrutiny.
  This paper provides the missing instrument. Drawing on the aviation certification paradigm, we propose a two-stage framework that transforms AI risk regulation into engineering practice. In Stage One, a competent authority formally fixes an acceptable failure probability $δ$ and an operational input domain $\varepsilon$ - a normative act with direct civil liability implications. In Stage Two, the RoMA and gRoMA statistical verification tools compute a definitive, auditable upper bound on the system's true failure rate, requiring no access to model internals and scaling to arbitrary architectures. We demonstrate how this certificate satisfies existing regulatory obligations, shifts accountability upstream to developers, and integrates with the legal frameworks that exist today.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套两阶段框架，将AI风险监管转化为可量化的工程实践，通过统计验证工具RoMA/gRoMA计算系统真实故障率的上界，填补了现有AI法规（如EU AI Act）中缺乏可量化安全阈值和验证方法的关键空白。
AI.motivation: 现有AI法规（EU AI Act、NIST框架、欧洲委员会公约）虽然要求高风险系统在部署前证明安全性，但没有给出"可接受风险"的量化定义，也没有提供技术验证方法。这一理论缺口在实践中尤为紧迫——开发者面临强制性合规评估却缺乏建立量化安全证据的方法论。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) 监管机构制定可接受的故障概率δ和操作输入域ε；(2) 使用RoMA和gRoMA统计验证工具，在不访问模型内部结构的情况下，计算系统真实故障率的确定性可审计上界。
AI.result: 该框架可生成满足现有法规义务的安全证书，将责任上移至开发者，并与现有法律体系整合。适用于任意架构的黑盒系统。
AI.conclusion: 航空认证范式可迁移至AI监管，填补了法规要求与工程技术之间的鸿沟，为高风险AI系统的安全验证提供了可操作的量化方法。
idea_en: A two-stage AI risk verification framework that converts qualitative regulatory requirements into quantifiable safety thresholds (acceptable failure probability δ and operational input domain ε) with direct civil liability implications.

RoMA (Risk-Oriented Model Assessment) statistical verification tool that computes a definitive auditable upper bound on system failure rate without requiring access to model internals, enabling black-box safety certification.

gRoMA (generalized RoMA) statistical verification tool that scales the failure rate bound computation to arbitrary AI architectures, overcoming white-box scrutiny limitations for opaque inference engines.

A method for integrating statistical safety certificates with existing AI regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST RMF, Council of Europe Convention) to fulfill mandatory conformity assessment obligations.
An aviation-certification-inspired paradigm for AI risk regulation that transforms normative risk acceptance into engineering verification practice, shifting accountability upstream to developers.
idea_ch: 一种将定性监管要求转化为可量化安全阈值（可接受故障概率δ和操作输入域ε）的两阶段AI风险验证框架，并赋予直接民事责任影响。
RoMA（面向风险的模型评估）统计验证工具，无需访问模型内部结构即可计算系统真实故障率的确定性可审计上界，实现黑盒安全认证。
gRoMA（广义RoMA）统计验证工具，将故障率上界计算方法扩展至任意AI架构，克服对不透明推理引擎的白盒审查限制。
一种将统计安全证书与现有AI监管框架（EU AI Act、NIST风险管理框架、欧洲委员会公约）整合的方法，以满足强制性合规评估义务。
受航空认证范式启发的AI风险监管方法，将规范性风险接受转化为工程验证实践，将责任上移至开发者端。

title: Nemobot Games: Crafting Strategic AI Gaming Agents for Interactive Learning with Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces a new paradigm for AI game programming, leveraging large language models (LLMs) to extend and operationalize Claude Shannon's taxonomy of game-playing machines. Central to this paradigm is Nemobot, an interactive agentic engineering environment that enables users to create, customize, and deploy LLM-powered game agents while actively engaging with AI-driven strategies. The LLM-based chatbot, integrated within Nemobot, demonstrates its capabilities across four distinct classes of games. For dictionary-based games, it compresses state-action mappings into efficient, generalized models for rapid adaptability. In rigorously solvable games, it employs mathematical reasoning to compute optimal strategies and generates human-readable explanations for its decisions. For heuristic-based games, it synthesizes strategies by combining insights from classical minimax algorithms (see, e.g., shannon1950chess) with crowd-sourced data. Finally, in learning-based games, it utilizes reinforcement learning with human feedback and self-critique to iteratively refine strategies through trial-and-error and imitation learning. Nemobot amplifies this framework by offering a programmable environment where users can experiment with tool-augmented generation and fine-tuning of strategic game agents. From strategic games to role-playing games, Nemobot demonstrates how AI agents can achieve a form of self-programming by integrating crowdsourced learning and human creativity to iteratively refine their own logic. This represents a step toward the long-term goal of self-programming AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的AI游戏编程新范式，通过Nemobot交互式代理工程环境实现Shannon游戏机器的分类扩展，涵盖四类游戏并支持用户创建、定制和部署LLM驱动的游戏代理，迈向自编程AI目标。
AI.motivation: 传统AI游戏编程方法往往针对特定游戏类型设计，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。本文旨在利用LLM的通用推理能力，结合Shannon的游戏机器分类法，构建一个统一的、可编程的AI游戏代理工程环境，实现从字典游戏到学习型游戏的全面覆盖，并最终探索AI自编程的可能性。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) 基于LLM的聊天机器人作为通用游戏引擎；(2) 针对字典游戏采用状态-动作映射压缩与泛化模型；(3) 针对严格可解游戏采用数学推理生成最优策略并附带可读解释；(4) 针对启发式游戏结合经典minimax算法与众包数据合成策略；(5) 针对学习型游戏采用强化学习+人类反馈+自我批评的迭代优化。Nemobot环境提供工具增强生成和微调能力。
AI.result: Nemobot在四类游戏中均展现出有效性：字典游戏快速适应、严格可解游戏提供最优策略及解释、启发式游戏融合经典算法与众包智慧、学习型游戏通过RLHF和自我批评迭代优化。整个系统展示了AI代理通过集成众包学习和人类创造力实现自我编程的潜力。
AI.conclusion: Nemobot证明了LLM驱动的游戏代理可以作为一种自编程AI的初步实现，通过融合人类反馈、众包学习和自我批评机制，AI能够迭代优化自身逻辑，为通用AI游戏编程和自主智能体的发展提供了新方向。

title: From Research Question to Scientific Workflow: Leveraging Agentic AI for Science Automation
summary: Scientific workflow systems automate execution -- scheduling, fault tolerance, resource management -- but not the semantic translation that precedes it. Scientists still manually convert research questions into workflow specifications, a task requiring both domain knowledge and infrastructure expertise. We propose an agentic architecture that closes this gap through three layers: an LLM interprets natural language into structured intents (semantic layer); validated generators produce reproducible workflow DAGs (deterministic layer); and domain experts author ``Skills'': markdown documents encoding vocabulary mappings, parameter constraints, and optimization strategies (knowledge layer). This decomposition confines LLM non-determinism to intent extraction: identical intents always yield identical workflows. We implement and evaluate the architecture on the 1000 Genomes population genetics workflow and Hyperflow WMS running on Kubernetes. In an ablation study on 150 queries, Skills raise full-match intent accuracy from 44% to 83%; skill-driven deferred workflow generation reduces data transfer by 92\%; and the end-to-end pipeline completes queries on Kubernetes with LLM overhead below 15 seconds and cost under $0.001 per query.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三层智能体架构，将自然语言研究问题自动转化为可执行科学工作流，通过语义层（LLM提取意图）、确定性层（生成可复现工作流DAG）和知识层（领域专家编写的Skill文档）将LLM的非确定性限制在意图提取阶段，确保相同意图始终产生相同工作流。
AI.motivation: 科学家仍需手动将研究问题转化为工作流规范，既需要领域知识又需要基础设施专业知识，这一过程效率低下且容易出错。
AI.method: 三层架构：1) 语义层（LLM将自然语言解析为结构化意图）；2) 确定性层（验证过的生成器产生可复现的工作流DAG）；3) 知识层（领域专家以Markdown文档编写Skill，包含词汇映射、参数约束和优化策略）。
AI.result: 在1000 Genomes群体遗传学工作流和Kubernetes上的Hyperflow WMS上评估，150个查询的消融研究中，Skill将完全匹配意图准确率从44%提升至83%；Skill驱动的延迟工作流生成减少92%数据传输；端到端流水线在Kubernetes上LLM开销低于15秒，每次查询成本低于$0.001。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM非确定性限制在意图提取阶段，结合确定性生成和专家知识编码，实现了从自然语言到可执行工作流的可靠自动化转换，兼具高准确率、低开销和经济性。
